items.title: Approve the Minutes of the December 10, 2019 Meeting
Allocate $1,519,125, with Conditions, and Appropriate $110,875 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds for 3 Requests
Approve the Participatory Budgeting Program of Projects Identified Through the Bayview Community Based Transportation Plan Process
Approve the 2019 San Francisco Congestion Management Program
Accept the Audit Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2019
Approve the Revised Debt Policy and Ratifying the Investment Policy
Allocate $3,330,000 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds, with Conditions, to San Francisco Public Works for Better Market Street 5th to 8th Street Design and Bikeway Pilot
Adopt an Oppose Unless Amended Position on Senate Bill 50 (Wiener) to Incorporate Transit Impact Mitigation Provisions
Adopt a Rail Program Manager Job Classification and Revised Organization Chart
Evaluation of Public Employee Performance and Recommend Approval of the Executive Director’s Performance Objectives for 2020
Adopt a Revised Salary Structure, Amendment of the Existing Employment Agreement and Setting the Annual Compensation for the Executive Director for 2020
